                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/winton-nfs/p/19865146" title="发布于 2026-04-14 14:11">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Openclaw TaskFlow究竟是什么？和普通Skill技能有什么区别</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain md-expand">TaskFlow任务流</span></h1>
<p class="md-end-block md-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">普通Skills技能 vs TaskFlow 技能</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">普通技能的特点：</span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 普通技能：一次性任务</span>
async <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> normalSkill() {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 执行任务</span>
  const result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await doSomething();
  
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 返回结果</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result;
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 结束！状态不保存</span>
}</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">TaskFlow 技能的特点：</span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> TaskFlow 技能：持久化工作流</span>
async <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> taskflowSkill() {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 创建持久化工作流</span>
  const flow =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await taskFlow.createManaged({
    goal: </span>"长期任务"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    stateJson: { step: </span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, data: {} }
  });
  
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 执行第一步（状态已保存）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  await doStep1();
  await taskFlow.updateState({ step: </span>2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
  
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 程序可以重启，状态不丢失！</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重启后可以从 step: 2 继续</span>
  
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 等待外部事件（几天、几周）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  await taskFlow.setWaiting({
    waitJson: { kind: </span>"user_reply", timeout: "7d"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
  });
  
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 用户一周后回复，工作流恢复</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  await taskFlow.resume();
  
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. 继续执行</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  await doStep2();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">核心区别对比表</span></h2>
<table class="md-table">
<thead>
<tr class="md-end-block"><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">特性</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">普通技能</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">TaskFlow 技能</span></span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">持久化</span></strong></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">❌ 重启后状态丢失</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">✅ 状态保存到数据库</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">长时间运行</span></strong></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">❌ 几分钟内完成</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">✅ 可以运行几天、几周</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">等待外部事件</span></strong></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">❌ 很难实现</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">✅ 内置等待机制</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">状态恢复</span></strong></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">❌ 从头开始</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">✅ 从上次状态继续</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">并发控制</span></strong></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">❌ 可能冲突</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">✅ 版本控制防冲突</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">任务链接</span></strong></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">❌ 独立任务</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">✅ 可以链接子任务</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">进度跟踪</span></strong></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">❌ 简单日志</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">✅ 结构化状态跟踪</span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">实际场景对比</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">场景：处理用户支持工单</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">普通技能实现：</span></strong></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 问题：如果程序重启，所有处理中的工单状态丢失！</span>
async <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handleSupportTicket(ticketId) {
  const ticket </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await getTicket(ticketId);
  
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 分类工单</span>
  const category =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await classify(ticket);
  
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (category === "urgent"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    await notifyOnCallEngineer(ticket);
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 等待工程师回复？很难实现！</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  }
  
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果程序在这里重启，工单处理状态完全丢失</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  await processTicket(ticket);
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">TaskFlow 实现：</span></strong></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>async <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> handleSupportTicket(ticketId) {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 创建持久化工作流</span>
  const flow =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await taskFlow.createManaged({
    goal: `处理工单 ${ticketId}`,
    stateJson: { ticketId, status: </span>"received"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
  });
  
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 分类工单</span>
  const category =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await classify(ticketId);
  await taskFlow.updateState({ status: </span>"classified"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, category });
  
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 根据分类处理</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (category === "urgent"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 通知值班工程师</span>
    const threadId =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await notifyOnCallEngineer(ticketId);
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 设置等待：等待工程师回复（可能几小时）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    await taskFlow.setWaiting({
      currentStep: </span>"waiting_engineer_reply"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
      waitJson: {
        kind: </span>"slack_reply"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        threadId: threadId,
        timeout: </span>"4h"  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4小时超时</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">      }
    });
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 程序可以重启！状态已保存</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 工程师3小时后回复，工作流自动恢复</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    
  } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (category === "normal"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 普通工单：自动处理</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    await autoProcess(ticketId);
    await taskFlow.finish({ status: </span>"resolved"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">为什么需要 TaskFlow？</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">1. <span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">可靠性需求</span></strong></span></span></h3>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">银行转账处理（不能因为重启而重复转账）</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">订单处理（需要保证状态不丢失）</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">数据同步（长时间运行，需要断点续传）</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">2. <span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">长时间运行需求</span></strong></span></span></h3>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">等待用户回复（可能几天）</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">定时批处理（每天运行）</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">监控任务（持续运行）</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">3. <span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">复杂协调需求</span></strong></span></span></h3>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">多个子任务需要协调</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">需要等待多个外部事件</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">需要人工干预点</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">4. <span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">状态恢复需求</span></strong></span></span></h3>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">程序升级后继续原有工作</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">故障恢复后继续处理</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">人工暂停/恢复能力</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">普通技能能做到吗？</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">技术上可以，但很困难：</span></strong></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自己实现持久化（复杂！）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">class MyWorkflow {
  constructor() {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 需要自己实现：</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 数据库存储</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 状态机</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 版本控制</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 4. 冲突解决</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 5. 等待机制</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 6. 恢复逻辑</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 7. 任务链接</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> ... 很多复杂代码</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">TaskFlow 提供了：</span></strong></span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">✅ 现成的持久化存储</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">✅ 完善的状态机</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">✅ 内置的版本控制</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">✅ 等待和恢复机制</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">✅ 任务链接管理</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">✅ 监控和调试工具</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">使用建议</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">使用普通技能当：</span></h3>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">一次性任务（几分钟内完成）</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">不需要保存状态</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">不需要等待外部事件</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">简单数据处理</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">使用 TaskFlow 当：</span></h3>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">长时间运行任务（几小时/几天）</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">需要保存状态防丢失</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">需要等待用户/外部系统回复</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">复杂多步骤工作流</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">需要可靠性和可恢复性</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">总结</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">TaskFlow 不是替代普通技能，而是补充：</span></strong></span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">普通技能</span></strong><span class="md-plain"> = <span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">工具</span></strong><span class="md-plain">（锤子、螺丝刀）</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">TaskFlow</span></strong><span class="md-plain"> = <span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">工作台</span></strong><span class="md-plain">（有抽屉存放半成品、有夹具固定工件）</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">你可以用锤子（普通技能）敲钉子，但如果你要做复杂的家具（长时间工作流），就需要工作台（TaskFlow）来：</span></p>
<ol class="ol-list" start="">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">存放半成品（状态持久化）</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">固定工件（状态管理）</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">等待胶水干（等待机制）</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">分步骤完成（多步骤协调）</span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">所以，<span class="md-pair-s "><strong><span class="md-plain">TaskFlow 是构建可靠、长时间运行工作流的基础设施</span></strong><span class="md-plain md-expand">，而普通技能是执行具体操作的"工具"。</span></span></span></p>

</div>
